changes.title: Make the configured test command runnable and the baseline suite green
changes.details: Install the dev extras into .venv with `uv sync --extra dev` (pre-approved; may create or update uv.lock) so `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q` runs, and make the two baseline failures deterministic without weakening them: tests/test_compliance_footer.py::test_a_long_french_reply_is_quick (asserts a long French reply is classified in under 2 s, line 873) and tests/test_people_finder.py::test_nested_testimonials_are_bounded (asserts 2,000-level nested testimonial HTML is scanned in under 1.0 s, line 413). Both guard against super-linear (pathological) processing; the replacement must still fail on a quadratic implementation, e.g. by comparing time at n and 2n or bounding work rather than wall-clock on a slow volume. Their pre-change digests and the 3,729 baseline test IDs are recorded as fixtures so the boundary can prove no test was deleted and these two kept their intent.

changes.title: Agree the interface between Sellbird and the shared platform (G7)
changes.details: Write docs/platform-interface.md and an OpenSpec capability spec defining what Sellbird needs from the shared platform: how the sellbird database and its least-privilege roles are provisioned on the shared flint-forge PG18, the flint-gate issuer, JWKS URL and minted-claims shape (aud=sellbird, sub=Kratos identity id), the hostname listener and certificate ownership on the shared Gateway, namespaces and secret names, and Kratos operator-identity provisioning. Mark it as the counterpart the new platform repository must satisfy; agreement is recorded by the operator. It also fixes the AI brain credential contract: the operator creates Secret `sellbird-claude` with key `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` (from `claude setup-token`, decision D4), consumed only as an environment variable, never written to disk or logged. Per operator decision (2026-11-18), Sellbird's production overlay, real hostname and digest pins live in the platform repository (which can be private), not in this public fork; the contract defines the overlay path there, the pin format the deploy bot writes, the Argo CD AppProject/Application ownership, and the repository variable naming the platform repo.

changes.title: Add a Postgres 18 storage backend beside SQLite with reversible migrations
changes.details: Register a psycopg 3 async backend behind sellbird/storage.py with a small dialect layer (placeholders, INSERT OR IGNORE/REPLACE, datetime/julianday, json_extract), versioned up/down migrations under migrations/postgres with a schema_version table, a foreign key from observations.signal_code to signal_codes, an outbox claim that is exactly-once under concurrent writers (UPDATE ... WHERE status RETURNING / SKIP LOCKED), a backend-neutral IntegrityError, and the dashboard's raw sqlite3 read and inline DDL routed through the seam. The app role has no DDL rights at runtime. SQLite behaviour is unchanged. Contract tests run against both backends, Postgres via a real flint-forge PG18 container.

changes.title: Hosted gateway mode: trust a flint-gate JWT, keep local token mode unchanged
changes.details: Add a config-selected gateway mode (never chosen by request headers) that allows a non-loopback bind, accepts the configured public Host and https Origin, verifies the gate-minted JWT against a pinned JWKS (iss, aud, kid, alg, exp) and an allowlisted Kratos sub, maps it to principal user, ignores cookies and unverified x-flint-*/forwarded headers, disables the agent token, and never prints the dashboard token. Local token mode stays the default and still refuses non-loopback binds.
